heading: INT. SALT-PORK STORAGE LOFT, SHIPYARD - EVENING, 1840s

units.text: INT. SALT-PORK STORAGE LOFT, SHIPYARD - EVENING, 1840s
A low-beamed room smelling of tar and brine.
Barrels line the walls.
A single oil lamp casts a shaky circle on the planks.
Rain drums the roof.
Six figures sit on barrel tops around a makeshift table of planks.
CAPTAIN EZEKIAL HOLLOWAY (50s, weathered, grey queue) presides.
Beside him is his first mate, SILAS PETHERBRIDGE (30s, red whiskers, cheerful).
Across from them sits the shipwright, OLUWASEUN ADEBAYO (40s, broad-shouldered, leather apron).
Next to him, the ship's cook, MRS. ABIGAIL FINCH (60s, spectacles, sleeves rolled).
At the end, young cabin boy JEREMIAH TUCKER (13, freckled, wide-eyed).
Lastly, the agent, MR. THEODORE VANE (40s, black coat, ink-stained fingers) sits stiffly apart.
Gentlemen. Madam. We sail Thursday if the weather holds.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: It won't, Captain.
units.name: PETHERBRIDGE

units.text: It will if I will it so.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: The hull will hold. The cargo is another question.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: The cargo is insured.
units.name: VANE

units.text: Insured against what, Mr. Vane? A woman cannot pickle a drowned ship.
units.name: FINCH

units.text: Against everything, Mrs. Finch.
units.name: VANE

units.text: Except honesty.
units.name: PETHERBRIDGE

units.text: Sir, what is the cargo?
units.name: JEREMIAH

units.text: Silence.
Vane looks to Holloway.
Holloway looks at his hands.
Tea, boy.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: Only tea?
units.name: JEREMIAH

units.text: Tea and what comes with it.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: Mr. Adebayo, I would remind you of your contract.
units.name: VANE

units.text: I made the contract in good faith. I did not know the ship was meant for Lisbon.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: Lisbon.
units.name: FINCH

units.text: A port like any other.
units.name: VANE

units.text: Not for what we carry.
units.name: PETHERBRIDGE

units.text: Enough.
units.name: HOLLOWAY

units.text: A long pause.
Rain on the roof.
I don't mind, sir. I can keep quiet.
units.name: JEREMIAH

units.text: That, child, is exactly what worries me.
units.name: FINCH
